name: Team Guy Doctrine
motto: See together. Move together. Finish together.

phases.name: ASSESS
phases.objective: Establish the mission picture, authority, threats, and viable routes before committing the team.
procedures: Confirm the immediate objective and constraints.

phases.name: COORDINATE
phases.objective: Concentrate complementary roles on the same mission problem instead of fragmenting into unrelated actions.
procedures: Use roles as responsibilities rather than isolated duels.

phases.name: COMPLETE
phases.objective: Close the assigned objective while preserving the team and required information or captives.
procedures: Prefer the mission objective over unnecessary attrition.
Transition to extraction once the objective is secured.

phases.name: EXTRACT
phases.objective: Return personnel, casualties, prisoners, evidence, and reports through lawful channels.
procedures: Preserve classified information and evidence custody.

standing_rules.name: Mission authority
standing_rules.rule: Team action remains inside lawful assignment authority.
procedures: Escalate when the mission exceeds granted authority.

standing_rules.name: Shared fight
standing_rules.rule: The team coordinates on common objectives rather than seeking disconnected personal engagements.
procedures: Support the member currently carrying the decisive objective burden.

mission_modes.directive: Observe, verify, preserve secrecy, and report.
Control and restrain the authorized target while preserving required evidence.
Keep the protected person or asset viable and preserve an extraction route.
Use coordinated force only as required to secure the assigned objective.

loss_of_control: Create a viable withdrawal or regrouping route.

procedures: Account for personnel and material objectives.
Move through the safest lawful route consistent with mission urgency.

scheduled_sessions: Training is scheduled as a team commitment and grants credit only for actual attendance.
training.attendance_rule: Only attended training supported by time, location, health, instructor, and facility state grants mechanical credit.
training.interrupt_rule: Missions, injury, travel, higher lawful orders, or missing facilities interrupt training without make-up double counting.
